ABOUT

YOUR WED STORIES

There is a whole world
inside a wedding.

The part you see. The part you feel. The part you didn’t notice until now.

We are drawn to weddings because nothing stands still for long. One room is full of music. In another, someone is fastening a necklace, finding a missing earring, or holding back a tear. There are stories happening everywhere, all at once.

At Your Wed Stories, photography and film are our way of paying attention. To the couple, of course, but also to the people who raised them, the friends who know every story, and the small rituals that make a celebration feel like home.

We love the thought that a photograph can surprise you years later. A familiar expression. Someone laughing in the background. A hand resting on your shoulder. The day returns through details like these.

“A wedding lasts a few days.
The people in the pictures
are your whole life.”

Your Wed Stories

That is what we want to make room for.

OUR INTENTION

When you look back,
we hope you find more
than how it looked.
We hope you find how it felt.

THE STILL FRAME

Photography

A glance can say everything.

Some photographs begin with a little direction: a place to stand, a turn towards the light. Others arrive without warning. We are interested in the conversation between the two.

Our photographs make space for portraits, family, ceremony and the unexpected moments that happen between them.

Explore the photographs

THE MOVING IMAGE

Filmmaking

Because some memories have a voice.

The pause before a speech. The sound of a room breaking into laughter. The way a familiar song brings everyone to their feet. A film gives those moments somewhere to live.

We bring together movement, sound and the rhythm of a celebration to tell a story you can step back into.
